name: Wedding
overview: Scripture reveals that a wedding marks the sacred union where a man leaves his parents to become one flesh with his wife, reflecting God's design for marriage from creation (Genesis 2:24; Matthew 19:4). The blessings of this union are emphasized, as finding a wife is described as finding a good and precious gift from the Lord (Proverbs 18:22; Proverbs 31:10). Furthermore, the strength and value of partnership are highlighted, portraying marriage as a bond that provides mutual support and resilience, likened to a threefold cord that is not easily broken (Ecclesiastes 4:9, 12).
